title: There is / there are: guided practice
titleEs: There is / there are: práctica guiada
instructionEs: Elige, decide y ordena. Fíjate en la estructura.

items.prompt: There ___ three bedrooms in my house.
items.explanationEs: Con un plural se usa there are.

items.prompt: There isn't ___ milk in the fridge.
items.explanationEs: En las negativas se usa any.

items.statement: In my city have many parks.
items.explanationEs: «Hay» no se dice con have: In my city there are many parks.

items.statement: There is a supermarket near my house.

items.explanationEs: En las preguntas se usa any, y are va antes de there.
Con sustantivos contables en plural: how many.
